host.description: Hostname or IP address to bind the web server to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

port.description: TCP port number for HTTP requests.

document_root.description: Filesystem path where static files are served from. Set to empty string ('') or omit to disable static file serving.

default_content_type.description: Default MIME type sent in the Content-Type header for dynamic responses.

ssl_certificate_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL enabled.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL enabled.

ssl_port.description: TCP port number for HTTPS requests (only used if SSL enabled).

max_threads.description: Maximum number of concurrent request-handling threads.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP connections allowed.

request_timeout.description: Seconds before idle connections are closed.

custom_log_file.description: Path to a file where server logs will be appended. Leave empty to log to stdout/stderr.

extra_mime_types.description: Additional MIME type mappings for static file extensions.

directory_template.description: Name of a Common Lisp symbol that defines a custom directory listing template (e.g., 'my-app::my-dir-template'). Set to 'nil' for default listing.

routes.description: List of URL routes and their handler functions.

handler.description: Common Lisp function name (symbol) that handles the request.

library_paths.description: List of paths to load before startup (e.g., additional system libraries).
